card.name: The word fatal in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "fatal" when it follows a linking word such as to, and, or, or including. It is used in warnings about serious adverse reactions.

modes.label: Fatal after including
modes.description: "fatal" comes after "including" in a list of serious outcomes.

modes.label: Fatal after and/or
modes.description: "fatal" is the last item in a series such as life-threatening and fatal.
modes.example: boxed warning. Life-threatening and<< fatal>> anaphylaxis, which can occur

modes.label: Fatal after to
modes.description: "fatal" follows "to" or "succumbing to" before a named reaction.
modes.example: diarrhea to<< fatal>> colitis. Treatment with antibacterial agents

card.plain: It marks the word fatal when a warning lists how bad a reaction can get.
